name: Progress bar
purpose: THE PROGRESS READING OF THE ONE METER MOLECULE. Use this when the value is a task underway and a full bar means DONE — uploads, downloads, multi-part transfers, savings goals, completeness scores. The geometry, the tokens, the states and the full spec live ONCE, in meter.meta.json; this record exists so 'Progress bar' stays a findable, selectable identity in the catalogue with its own category, per s210-D5.

aliasOf.why: A progress meter measures a task you WANT to complete: full is success. That is the meaning half of the split Dave named at #210 — 'they are the same molecule but they are categorised and might actually be different items when selecting them from the store'. Same molecule, different reading.
